classes.name: Barbarian
classes.description: Barbarians are mighty warriors who are powered by primal forces of the multiverse that manifest as a Rage. More than a mere emotion—and not limited to anger—this Rage is an incarnation of a predator’s ferocity, a storm's fury, and a sea's turmoil.

features.name: Rage
features.description: You can imbue yourself with a primal power called Rage. You can enter it as a Bonus Action if you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

benefits.name: Damage Resistance
benefits.description: You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

benefits.name: Rage Damage
benefits.description: When you make an attack using Strength and deal damage, you gain a bonus shown in the Rage Damage column.

benefits.name: Strength Advantage
benefits.description: You have Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

benefits.name: No Concentration or Spells
benefits.description: You can't maintain Concentration, and you can't cast spells.

features.extension: Attack an enemy, force a save, or use a Bonus Action to extend.
features.refresh: Regain 1 use on Short Rest, all on Long Rest.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While you aren't wearing any armor, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Constitution modifiers. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Use mastery properties of weapons. Change one choice after a Long Rest.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: Advantage on Strength attack rolls until start of next turn, but attacks against you also have Advantage.

features.name: Primal Knowledge
features.description: Gain one Barbarian skill proficiency. While Raging, you can use Strength for Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival checks.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.description: Advantage on Initiative rolls.

features.name: Instinctive Pounce
features.description: As part of entering Rage, you can move up to half your Speed.

features.name: Brutal Strike
features.description: If using Reckless Attack, forgo Advantage on one attack for +1d10 damage and an effect.

options.name: Forceful Blow
options.description: Push target 15ft away; you can move half speed toward them without Opportunity Attacks.

options.name: Hamstring Blow
options.description: Target's Speed reduced by 15ft until start of your next turn.

features.name: Relentless Rage
features.description: If reduced to 0 HP while Raging, make a DC 10 Con save to drop to 2x Level HP instead. DC increases by 5 each use until rest.

features.name: Improved Brutal Strike
features.description: New Brutal Strike options available.

options.name: Staggering Blow
options.description: Target has Disadvantage on its next save and can't make Opportunity Attacks until start of your next turn.

options.name: Sundering Blow
options.description: Next attack by another creature against target gains +5 bonus.

features.name: Persistent Rage
features.description: Regain all Rages on Initiative (once per Long Rest). Rage lasts 10 minutes without needing to extend; ends only if Unconscious or wearing Heavy armor.

features.name: Improved Brutal Strike (2)
features.description: Extra damage increases to 2d10. Use two different effects at once.

features.name: Indomitable Might
features.description: Use Strength score in place of total for Strength check/save if roll is lower.

features.name: Primal Champion
features.description: Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

classes.name: Bard
classes.description: Invoking magic through music, dance, and verse, Bards are expert at inspiring others, soothing hurts, disheartening foes, and creating illusions.

traits: One Musical Instrument of your choice

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.description: As a Bonus Action, give a Bardic Inspiration die to a creature within 60ft. Once within the next hour when they fail a D20 Test, they can roll the die and add it to the d20. (Die becomes d8 at L5, d10 at L10, d12 at L15).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Charisma is your spellcasting ability. You use a Musical Instrument as a focus. You know cantrips and prepare spells of level 1+ based on the Bard Features table.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies. At level 9, gain Expertise in two more.

features.name: Jack of all Trades
features.description: Add half your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check that lacks proficiency and doesn't otherwise use your PB.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.description: Regain all expended uses of Bardic Inspiration on a Short Rest as well as Long. Also, expend a spell slot to regain one use.

features.name: Countercharm
features.description: When you or a creature within 30ft fails a save against being Charmed or Frightened, use a Reaction to reroll with Advantage.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.description: When your Prepared Spells number increases or you replace a spell, you can choose spells from the Bard, Cleric, Druid, and Wizard lists. They count as Bard spells.

features.name: Superior Inspiration
features.description: When you roll Initiative, regain uses of Bardic Inspiration until you have two (if you had fewer).

features.name: Words of Creation
features.description: Always have Power Word: Heal and Power Word: Kill prepared. When you cast either, you can target a second creature within 10ft of the first.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: Clerics draw power from the realms of the gods and harness it to work miracles. Blessed by a deity, a pantheon, or another immortal entity, a Cleric can reach out to the divine magic of the Outer Planes—where gods dwell—and channel it to bolster people and battle foes.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Wisdom is your spellcasting ability. You use a Holy Symbol as a focus. You know cantrips and prepare spells of level 1+ based on the Cleric Features table. Change your prepared spells on a Long Rest.

features.name: Divine Order
features.description: You dedicate yourself to a sacred role.

options.name: Protector
options.description: Gain proficiency with Martial weapons and Heavy armor.

options.name: Thaumaturge
options.description: Gain one extra cantrip and a bonus to Arcana/Religion checks equal to Wisdom modifier (min +1).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.refresh: Regain 1 use on Short Rest, all on Long Rest
features.description: Channel divine energy for magical effects. DCs use your spell save DC.

options.name: Divine Spark
options.description: Target a creature within 30ft. Roll 1d8 + Wis mod. Restore that much HP, or force a Con save to deal that much Necrotic/Radiant damage (half on success). Damage dice increases at L7 (2d8), L13 (3d8), and L18 (4d8).

options.name: Turn Undead
options.description: Undead within 30ft make a Wis save or are Frightened and Incapacitated for 1 minute. They must move away from you. Ends early on damage.

features.name: Sear Undead
features.description: When you use Turn Undead, roll d8s equal to your Wis mod (min 1d8). Undead that fail the save take Radiant damage equal to the total. This doesn't end the turn effect.

features.name: Blessed Strikes
features.description: Infuse your attacks with divine power. Choose one:

options.name: Divine Strike
options.description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, deal an extra 1d8 Necrotic or Radiant damage.

options.name: Potent Spellcasting
options.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of any Cleric cantrip.

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.description: Cast any Cleric spell of level 5 or lower without expending a slot or components. Can't use again until a Long Rest.

features.name: Improved Blessed Strikes
features.description: Your chosen Blessed Strike improves.

options.name: Divine Strike
options.description: Extra damage increases to 2d8.

options.name: Potent Spellcasting
options.description: When dealing damage with a cantrip, grant Temp HP equal to twice your Wis mod to yourself or an ally within 60ft.

features.name: Greater Divine Intervention
features.description: When using Divine Intervention, you can choose Wish. If you do, you can't use Divine Intervention again for 2d4 Long Rests.

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: Druids belong to ancient orders that call on the forces of nature. Harnessing the magic of animals, plants, and the four elements, Druids heal, transform into animals, and wield elemental destruction.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Wisdom is your spellcasting ability. You use a Druidic Focus as a focus. You know cantrips and prepare spells of level 1+ based on the Druid Features table. Change your prepared spells on a Long Rest.

features.name: Druidic
features.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of Druids. You also always have the Speak with Animals spell prepared. You can leave hidden messages in Druidic (DC 15 Investigation to spot, but undecipherable without magic).

features.name: Primal Order
features.description: You dedicate yourself to a sacred role.

options.name: Magician
options.description: Gain one extra cantrip and a bonus to Arcana/Nature checks equal to Wisdom modifier (min +1).

options.name: Warden
options.description: Gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.refresh: Regain 1 use on Short Rest, all on Long Rest
features.description: Shape-shift into a Beast form. Lasts for hours equal to half your Druid level. You gain Temp HP equal to your Druid level. You retain your personality, Int/Wis/Cha scores, and class features, but can't cast spells.

features.name: Wild Companion
features.description: Expend a spell slot or a use of Wild Shape to cast Find Familiar without Material components. The familiar is Fey and disappears after a Long Rest.

features.name: Wild Resurgence
features.description: If you have no uses of Wild Shape, you can expend a spell slot to regain one use (once per turn, no action). Additionally, you can expend one use of Wild Shape to regain a level 1 spell slot (once per Long Rest).

features.name: Elemental Fury
features.description: The might of the elements flows through you. Choose one:

options.name: Potent Spellcasting
options.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of any Druid cantrip.

options.name: Primal Strike
options.description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon or Beast form attack, deal an extra 1d8 Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage.

features.name: Improved Elemental Fury
features.description: Your chosen Elemental Fury improves.

options.name: Potent Spellcasting
options.description: When you cast a Druid cantrip with a range of 10+ feet, the range increases by 300 feet.

options.name: Primal Strike
options.description: The extra damage increases to 2d8.

features.name: Beast Spells
features.description: While in Wild Shape, you can cast spells in Beast form (except spells requiring costly or consumed Material components).

features.name: Archdruid
features.description: Gain the following benefits:

benefits.name: Evergreen Wild Shape
benefits.description: Regain one expended use of Wild Shape when you roll Initiative and have none left.

benefits.name: Nature Magician
benefits.description: Convert unexpended uses of Wild Shape into a single spell slot (2 spell levels per use) once per Long Rest.

benefits.name: Longevity
benefits.description: For every ten years that pass, your body ages only one year.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: Fighters rule many battlefields. Questing knights, royal champions, elite soldiers, and hardened mercenaries - as Fighters, they all share an unparalleled prowess with weapons and armor. And they are well acquainted with death, both meting it out and defying it.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can replace the feat you chose with a different Fighting Style feat.

features.name: Second Wind
features.refresh: Regain 1 use on Short Rest, all on Long Rest
features.description: As a Bonus Action, regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 + your Fighter level.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Use mastery properties of weapons. Change one choice after a Long Rest.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: On your turn, take one additional action, except the Magic action. Can use twice before a rest starting at level 17 (only once per turn).

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.description: When you fail an ability check, expend a use of Second Wind to roll 1d10 and add it to the check. If it still fails, the use isn't expended.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Tactical Shift
features.description: When you activate Second Wind, move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Indomitable
features.description: If you fail a saving throw, reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level. Must use new roll.

features.name: Tactical Master
features.description: When you attack with a weapon whose mastery property you can use, replace it with Push, Sap, or Slow for that attack.

features.name: Two Extra Attacks
features.description: Attack three times instead of once whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Studied Attacks
features.description: If you miss an attack roll, gain Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Three Extra Attacks
features.description: Attack four times instead of once whenever you take the Attack action.

classes.name: Monk
classes.description: Monks use rigorous combat training and mental discipline to align themselves with the multiverse and focus their internal reservoirs of power. They strive to turn themselves into living weapons.

choice.options: Any type of Artisan's Tools or Musical Instrument

weapon_proficiencies: Martial weapons with the Light property

features.name: Martial Arts
features.description: Mastery of combat styles using Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons (Simple Melee and Martial Melee with Light property). Gain Dexterous Attacks (use Dex for Str attacks/saves), Bonus Unarmed Strike, and Martial Arts Die damage.

benefits.name: Bonus Unarmed Strike
benefits.description: Make one Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.

benefits.name: Martial Arts Die
benefits.description: Use your Martial Arts die (scaling by level) for Unarmed Strikes or Monk weapons.

benefits.name: Dexterous Attacks
benefits.description: Use Dex instead of Str for attack/damage rolls and Grapple/Shove save DCs.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While wearing no armor and no shield, AC = 10 + Dex + Wis.

features.name: Monk's Focus
features.description: Expend Focus Points to fuel special features.

options.name: Flurry of Blows
options.description: Make two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action.

options.name: Patient Defense
options.description: Take Disengage action. Or spend 1 point for both Disengage and Dodge.

options.name: Step of the Wind
options.description: Take Dash action. Or spend 1 point for both Disengage and Dash; jump distance doubles.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.description: Speed increases while wearing no armor or shield. Bonus scales with level.

features.name: Uncanny Metabolism
features.description: When you roll Initiative, regain all Focus Points and heal HP equal to Monk level + Martial Arts die.

features.name: Deflect Attacks
features.description: Reduce Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage by 1d10 + Dex + Monk level. If reduced to 0, spend 1 Focus Point to redirect force (2 rolls of Martial Arts die + Dex) to a creature within 5ft (melee) or 60ft (ranged).

features.name: Slow Fall
features.description: Reduce fall damage by 5 x Monk level.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice per Attack action.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.description: Once per turn on a hit, spend 1 Focus Point for a Con save. Fail: Stunned until start of your next turn. Success: Speed halved and next attack against it has Advantage.

features.name: Empowered Strikes
features.description: Unarmed Strikes can deal Force damage instead of normal type.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: No damage on successful Dex save for half; half on failure.

features.name: Acrobatic Movement
features.description: Move along vertical surfaces and across liquids without falling.

features.name: Heightened Focus
features.description: Improved Flurry (3 strikes), Patient Defense (Temp HP), and Step of the Wind (Move a Large- creature with you).

features.name: Self-Restoration
features.description: Remove Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned at the end of each turn. No Exhaustion from lack of food/drink.

features.name: Deflect Energy
features.description: Deflect Attacks now works against any damage type.

features.name: Disciplined Survivor
features.description: Proficiency in all saving throws. Spend 1 Focus Point to reroll failed save.

features.name: Perfect Focus
features.description: Regain Focus points to 4 on Initiative if you have 3 or fewer (and didn't use Uncanny Metabolism).

features.name: Superior Defense
features.description: Spend 3 Focus Points for Resistance to all damage except Force for 1 minute.

features.name: Body and Mind
features.description: Dexterity and Wisdom increase by 4 (max 25).

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: Paladins are united by their oaths to stand against the forces of annihilation and corruption. They are devout warriors who become blessed champions, secondary only to the magical power they wield to heal, smite, and protect.

features.name: Lay On Hands
features.description: Restore HP from a pool equal to 5 x Level. As a Bonus Action, touch a creature to heal any amount from the pool. Or spend 5 points to remove the Poisoned condition.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Charisma is your spellcasting ability. You use a Holy Symbol as a focus. Prepare spells of level 1+ based on the Paladin Features table. Change your prepared spells on a Long Rest.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Use mastery properties of 2 kinds of weapons. Change choices after a Long Rest.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Gain a Fighting Style feat or choose Blessed Warrior (learn 2 Cleric cantrips, Charisma-based).

features.name: Paladin's Smite
features.description: Always have Divine Smite prepared. Cast once per Long Rest without a slot, or use available slots.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.refresh: Regain 1 use on Short Rest, all on Long Rest
features.description: Channel divine energy for magical effects.

options.name: Divine Sense
options.description: Detect Celestials, Fiends, and Undead within 60ft, and Hallow-style effects for 10 minutes.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice per Attack action.

features.name: Faithful Steed
features.description: Always have Find Steed prepared. Cast once per Long Rest without a slot, or use available slots.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.description: You and allies within 10ft gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier (min +1). Inactive if Incapacitated.

features.name: Abjure Foes
features.description: Target Cha mod creatures within 60ft. Wis save or Frightened for 1 minute. While Frightened, they can only move, act, OR bonus act.

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.description: You and allies within your Aura of Protection are immune to the Frightened condition.

features.name: Radiant Strikes
features.description: Melee attacks and Unarmed Strikes deal an extra 1d8 Radiant damage.

features.name: Restoring Touch
features.description: Spend 5 HP from Lay on Hands to remove Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned.

features.name: Aura Expansion
features.description: Aura of Protection (and related auras) expansion to 30ft.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: Rangers keep unending watch in the wilderness, tracking quarry like predators and harnessing primal powers to protect the world from monsters and tyrants.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Wisdom is your spellcasting ability. You use a Druidic Focus as a focus. Prepare spells of level 1+ based on the Ranger Features table. Change your prepared spells on a Long Rest.

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: Always have Hunter's Mark prepared. Cast it without a slot a number of times equal to the Favored Enemy column. Regain uses on Long Rest.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Use mastery properties of 2 kinds of weapons. Change choices after a Long Rest.

features.name: Deft Explorer
features.description: Gain Expertise in one skill proficiency and learn two languages.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Gain a Fighting Style feat or choose Druidic Warrior (learn 2 Druid cantrips, Wisdom-based).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice per Attack action.

features.name: Roving
features.description: Speed increases by 10ft while not in Heavy armor. Gain Climb and Swim speeds equal to your Speed.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Gain Expertise in two more skill proficiencies.

features.name: Tireless
features.description: As a Magic action, gain 1d8 + Wis mod Temp HP (uses = Wis mod). Decrease Exhaustion level by 1 on a Short Rest.

features.name: Relentless Hunter
features.description: Damage can't break your Concentration on Hunter's Mark.

features.name: Nature's Veil
features.description: As a Bonus Action, become Invisible until the end of your next turn (uses = Wis mod).

features.name: Precise Hunter
features.description: Advantage on attack rolls against your Hunter's Mark target.

features.name: Feral Senses
features.description: Gain 30ft of Blindsight.

features.name: Foe Slayer
features.description: Hunter's Mark damage die increases to d10.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: Rogues rely on cunning, stealth, and their foes' vulnerabilities to get the upper hand in any situation. They have a knack for finding the solution to just about any problem.

weapon_proficiencies: Martial weapons with the Finesse or Light property

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Gain Expertise in two skill proficiencies. At Rogue level 6, gain Expertise in two more.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Once per turn, deal extra damage to a creature hit with a Finesse or Ranged weapon if you have Advantage or an ally is within 5ft. Damage scales with level.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.description: Know Thieves' Cant and one other language of your choice.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Use mastery properties of 2 kinds of weapons. Change choices after a Long Rest.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: Take Dash, Disengage, or Hide action as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Steady Aim
features.description: Gain Advantage on next attack roll this turn. Speed becomes 0 until end of turn. Can't move before using.

features.name: Cunning Strike
features.description: Forgo Sneak Attack dice for effects. Save DC uses Dex.

options.name: Poison
options.description: Con save or Poisoned for 1 minute (requires Poisoner's Kit).

options.name: Trip
options.description: Large or smaller targets make Dex save or knocked Prone.

options.name: Withdraw
options.description: Move up to half speed without Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.description: Halve damage from an attack you can see.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: No damage on successful Dex save for half; half on failure. Inactive if Incapacitated.

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.description: Treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower as 10 for proficient skill/tool checks.

features.name: Improved Cunning Strike
features.description: Use up to two Cunning Strike effects simultaneously, paying die costs for each.

features.name: Devious Strikes
features.description: New Cunning Strike options available.

options.name: Daze
options.description: Con save or target can only move, act, or bonus act on next turn.

options.name: Knock Out
options.description: Con save or Unconscious for 1 minute/damage.

options.name: Obscure
options.description: Dex save or Blinded until end of your next turn.

features.name: Slippery Mind
features.description: Gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

features.name: Elusive
features.description: Attackers can't have Advantage against you unless you are Incapacitated.

features.name: Stroke of Luck
features.description: Turn a failed d20 Test into a 20 once per rest.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.description: Sorcerers wield innate magic that is stamped into their being. Sorcerers don’t learn magic; the raw, roiling power of magic is part of them. The essential art of a Sorcerer is learning to harness and channel that innate magic.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Charisma is your spellcasting ability. You use an Arcane Focus. You know cantrips and prepare spells of level 1+ based on the Sorcerer Features table. Change your prepared spells on a level up.

features.name: Innate Sorcery
features.description: Unleash magic for 1 minute: spell save DC of Sorcerer spells increases by 1, and you have Advantage on attack rolls of Sorcerer spells.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.description: You have Sorcery Points to fuel magical effects. Expend a slot to gain points equal to slot level. Transform points into a slot as a Bonus Action (Level 1: 2 SP, L2: 3 SP, L3: 5 SP, L4: 6 SP, L5: 7 SP).

features.name: Metamagic
features.description: Gain two Metamagic options to temporarily modify spells by spending Sorcery Points. Only one option per spell usually. Gain two more at L10 and L17.

options.name: Careful Spell
options.description: When creatures make a save against your spell, protect up to your Charisma modifier creatures. They automatically succeed and take no damage if they would normally take half.

options.name: Distant Spell
options.description: Double a spell's range (if 5ft+), or make a Touch range spell 30ft.

options.name: Empowered Spell
options.description: Reroll up to Charisma modifier damage dice; must use new rolls. Can use alongside other Metamagic.

options.name: Extended Spell
options.description: Double duration of a spell (1 min+) to max 24 hours. Gain Advantage on Concentration saves for that spell.

options.name: Heightened Spell
options.description: Give one target of a spell Disadvantage on saves against it.

options.name: Quickened Spell
options.description: Change casting time of an action spell to a Bonus Action. Can't cast another level 1+ spell this turn.

options.name: Seeking Spell
options.description: If you miss a spell attack, reroll the d20. Can use alongside other Metamagic.

options.name: Subtle Spell
options.description: Cast without Verbal, Somatic, or Material components (unless costly or consumed).

options.name: Transmuted Spell
options.description: Change damage type to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder.

options.name: Twinned Spell
options.description: For spells that target additional creatures when upcast, increase the effective level by 1.

features.name: Sorcerous Restoration
features.description: On a Short Rest, regain expended Sorcery Points up to half your Sorcerer level (round down). Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Sorcery Incarnate
features.description: If you have no uses of Innate Sorcery left, you can activate it by spending 2 Sorcery Points. While active, you can use up to two Metamagic options on each spell.

features.name: Arcane Apotheosis
features.description: While Innate Sorcery is active, you can use one Metamagic option on each of your turns without spending Sorcery Points.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.description: Warlocks quest for knowledge hidden in the fabric of the multiverse, forming binding pacts with powerful patrons to piece together arcane secrets and bolster their own power.

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
features.description: Unearthed forbidden knowledge. Gain invocations of your choice based on the Invocations column. You can replace one invocation whenever you gain a Warlock level.

features.name: Pact Magic
features.description: Charisma is your spellcasting ability. You use an Arcane Focus. You have a limited number of spell slots that are all the same level (scaling up to 5th). Regain slots on a Short or Long Rest. Prepare spells based on the Warlock Features table.

features.name: Magical Cunning
features.description: Regain half your maximum Pact Magic spell slots (round up).

features.name: Contact Patron
features.description: Always have Contact Other Plane prepared. Cast once per Long Rest without a slot to contact your patron; automatically succeed on the saving throw.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum
features.description: Choose one spell of level 6+ (increasing at L13, L15, L17) as an arcanum. Cast each arcanum spell once per Long Rest without a slot. Can replace one on level up.

features.name: Eldritch Master
features.description: When you use Magical Cunning, regain all expended Pact Magic spell slots.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: Wizards are defined by their exhaustive study of magic's inner workings. They cast spells of explosive fire, arcing lightning, subtle deception, and spectacular transformations.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability. You use an Arcane Focus or your Spellbook. You know cantrips and prepare spells from your Spellbook based on the Wizard Features table. Change your prepared spells on a Long Rest. Replace one cantrip on a Long Rest.

features.name: Spellbook
features.description: Your spellbook contains 6 level 1 Wizard spells initially. Add 2 spells of eligible level each level up. You can copy found spells (2 hours, 50 GP per level). Prepare your spells from this book.

features.name: Ritual Adept
features.description: You can cast any spell with the Ritual tag from your spellbook as a ritual, even if not prepared, by reading from the book.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: Once per Long Rest, during a Short Rest, recover expended spell slots with a combined level equal to half your Wizard level (round up). Max slot level recovered is 5th.

features.name: Scholar
features.description: Gain Expertise in one skill: Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion (must already have proficiency).

features.name: Memorize Spell
features.description: When you finish a Short Rest, you can study your spellbook to swap one prepared spell for another.

features.name: Spell Mastery
features.description: Choose a level 1 and level 2 spell from your spellbook (casting time: action). Always have them prepared, and cast them at their lowest level without expending a slot. Change choices on a Long Rest.

features.name: Signature Spells
features.description: Choose two level 3 spells. Always have them prepared, and cast each once at level 3 without expending a slot per Short/Long Rest.

classes.name: Artificer
classes.description: Masters of invention, Artificers use ingenuity and magic to unlock extraordinary capabilities in objects, decoding and harnessing magic in their spells and inventions.

multiclassing.note: Add half your Artificer levels (round up) when determining multiclass spell slots.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability. You must use tools (Thieves’, Tinker’s, or Artisan’s) as a focus. You know cantrips and prepare level 1+ spells from the Artificer list. Change your prepared spells or one cantrip on a Long Rest.

features.name: Tinker's Magic
features.description: Learn Mending. Create one mundane item (last until Long Rest) from a specified list using Tinker's Tools.

features.name: Replicate Magic Item
features.description: Learn arcane plans to create temporary magic items. Create specified number of items at the end of a Long Rest. Items last until you die (1d4 days later) or the plan is replaced.

features.name: Magic Item Tinker
features.description: Gain new options for Replicate Magic Item: Charge Item (spend slot to recharge), Drain Item (destroy item for temporary spell slot), or Transmute Item (transform item into another known plan).

features.name: Flash of Genius
features.description: When you or an ally within 30ft fails a check or save, add your Int modifier to the roll.

features.name: Magic Item Adept
features.description: You can attune to up to four magic items at once.

features.name: Spell-Storing Item
features.description: Store a level 1-3 Artificer spell (1 action) in a weapon or focus. A creature can use a Magic action to produce the spell's effect. Replaces any existing stored spell.

features.name: Advanced Artifice
features.description: Attune to up to five magic items. Regain one use of Flash of Genius on a Short Rest.

features.name: Magic Item Master
features.description: Attune to up to six magic items at once.

features.name: Soul of Artifice
features.description: Cheat Death: Disintegrate Uncommon/Rare infusions to drop to 20 HP per item instead of 0. Magical Guidance: Regain all Flash of Genius uses on Short Rest if attuned to at least one magic item.
